title: NERDPOLE Quests
description: A simple Paper 1.21.8 plugin that adds a small assortment of weekly quests that reward you diamonds upon completion! Made for my private SMP server, NERDPOLE.
body:
A plugin that I commissioned from the very talented [TaintedFrameworks](https://youtube.com/@taintedframeworks?si=s8AExpRsXn2QB7Ao) that adds quests to Minecraft. It kinda exists to fill a very specific niche in my personal Minecraft server, NERDPOLE, which uses a diamond-based economy system (similar to Hermitcraft!), so it isn't very configurable at all.

This plugin aims to provide players a way to earn a small amount of diamonds without mining, rewarding exploration and task completion. For those of us that hate strip-mining. Lol.
(You could use this plugin in a singleplayer environment, but some of the Survivor's quests require you to kill other players to claim rewards, so some quests will be impossible.)

Commands:

```
/quests - displays this week's quests. For operators only.
/quests spawn [adventurer/survivor] - summons the Questgiver villager. Interact with this villager to accept and turn in quests.
```

Quests must be started by taking them from the Questgiver Villager. "Retrieve" quests require you to hand items into the Questgiver, in exhange for the reward. Other quests, that require you to mine blocks or kill mobs, are automatically tracked once the quest is accepted.

There are two different kinds of quests: "Adventurer's" and "Survivor's".

"Adventurer's" quests are personal, player-to-player, meaning each player has access to their own quests. There are five of them every week: Two are "Easy", and reward 1 diamond upon completion, Two are "Intermediate" and reward 2 diamonds upon completion, and the final quest is "Hard" and rewards 3 diamonds upon completion. They are refreshed every week. Each are randomly pulled from their respective pools each week.



"Survivor's" quests are global, meaning that every player sees the same quests, and when one player completes one, it is completed for everyone. This makes the Survivor's quests a bit of a race to complete, and that is intentional! Additionally, they are more difficult, and therefore, more rewarding. There are five of them every week: Two are "Challenging", and reward 5 diamonds upon completion, Two are "Difficult", and reward 7 diamonds upon completion, and the final quest is "Punishing" and rewards 9 diamonds upon completion. They are refreshed every week. Each are randomly pulled from their respective pools each week.
